summary: Bulletin export must not truncate an existing output file until the notice scan and encode both succeed.
reason: The generated exporter opens --output with O_TRUNC before reading. A notice-index failure after that open erases the previous backup. A regen must write the finished payload aside and replace the destination only after success, leaving the previous file intact on failure.
validated_outcome: A failed bulletin scan leaves the previous --output bytes in place and removes its temporary file.
